title: How to Make Wealth: startups as measurement plus leverage for working fast
summary: Paul Graham argues that wealth is what people want, not money, and that startups let small groups of ambitious people work as hard as possible on hard technical problems and get paid in proportion. The recipe is measurement (small teams) and leverage (new technology), with users as the test of whether you created wealth.

principles.text: Wealth is what people want, not money. Businesses make money by creating wealth, so start by doing something people want.
principles.quote: People think that what a business does is make money. But money is just the intermediate stage-- just a shorthand-- for whatever people want. What most businesses really do is make wealth. They do something people want.
